definition: Reviewed climate-related account lens covering mitigation and clean energy plus adaptation and resilience. Whole-account totals are not climate-only allocations. Climate-science budgets cannot yet be separated from broad science accounts.

accounts.basis: Pre-disaster mitigation supports resilience to weather-related hazards, and also includes other hazards.
accounts.coverage: Climate-related, mixed-purpose account; the full amount is not a climate-only allocation.

accounts.name: Green and Resilient Retrofit Program for Multifamily Housing
accounts.basis: Green and Resilient Retrofit supports energy and water efficiency and resilience in housing.
accounts.coverage: Climate-related, mixed-purpose account; the full amount is not a climate-only allocation.

limitations: This is a reviewed, non-exhaustive climate-related account lens, not a comprehensive federal climate budget. Whole-account obligations can include other activities.
It covers reviewed mitigation and clean energy accounts and selected adaptation/resilience accounts. It excludes broad fossil-energy research and oil/gas development.

Large mixed science budgets such as NOAA Operations, Research and Facilities and NASA Science cannot be assigned a defensible climate-only share from these account data and are omitted; climate science is therefore undercounted.
The existing non-financing and entitlement/interest scope exclusions still apply. No estimated climate-only dollar shares are introduced.
